question: How does the broker detect and drop duplicate records from an idempotent producer?

steps.does: assigns producer id, epoch and per-partition sequence once; retries keep the sequence
batch reaches the log via the produce path
for client appends looks up the producer's last entry
duplicate if epoch matches and first/last sequence exactly match one of the last 5 cached batches
on duplicate skips localLog.append and returns the original offsets from cached BatchMetadata
non-duplicates are validated; gaps raise OutOfOrderSequenceException
after append, caches batch metadata for future dedup
